                   "Colorful Image Colorization" (ECCV 2016, used as "Vivid") and "Real-Time User-Guided Image Colorization" (SIGGRAPH 2017,
                   used as "Natural") models by Richard Zhang, Phillip Isola, Alexei A. Efros et al., BSD 2-Clause License,
                   https://github.com/richzhang/colorization (full licence text in onnx/LICENSE-colorization.txt). Converted from the
                   official PyTorch weights to ONNX by GetToolNest, with weights stored as 8-bit integers (per-channel) to reduce download size.
